newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Fire kills six, injures 10 in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Fire kills six, injures 10 in Karachi.

text.p: Six people were killed and 10 injured when a fire swept through a residential building in Pakistan's southern city of Karachi on Monday, police and rescue workers said.
They said four of the dead were from the same family and included a three-year-old child. The fifth was a security guard. Doctors said a one-year-old girl died in hospital later.
The fire, apparently caused by an electrical short-circuit, broke out at about 5.15 a.m. (0015 GMT) in the congested Ranchor Lines area of District South.
